crossRefs.note: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is…
This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors…
In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…

translations.web: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
translations.bsb: What does the worker gain from his toil?
translations.kjv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
translations.asv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?
